fullPassage: As a political researcher in Germany, Noelle-Neumann observed that during election campaigns, certain views seemed to get more play than others, and sometimes people muted their opinions rather than talking about them, especially if those opinions were perceived to be unpopular. Noelle-Neumann calls this the spiral of silence. The spiral of silence occurs when individuals who perceive that their opinions are popular express them, whereas those who do not think their opinions are popular remain quiet. This process occurs in a spiral, so that one side of an issue ends up with considerable publicity and the other side with very little. In everyday life, people express their opinions in a variety of ways: they talk about them, they wear buttons, they put bumper stickers on their cars, and they post their views on social media. According to this theory, people are more apt to do these kinds of things when they perceive that others share their opinions.

det.analysis: __________ (expression) them — 주어 individuals who... 에 대한 동사가 필요. expression(명사) → express(동사, 표현하다)
det.tip: express them — 그것을 표현하다. expression(명사) → express(동사)

questions.passage: Noelle-Neumann observed that during election campaigns, certain views seemed to get more play than others, __________ (especial) if those opinions were perceived to be unpopular.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: __________ (especial) if those opinions — 조건절을 수식하는 부사가 필요. especial(형용사) → especially(부사, 특히)
det.tip: especially if — 특히 ~한다면. especial(형용사) → especially(부사)

questions.passage: As a political researcher in Germany, Noelle-Neumann observed that during election campaigns, certain views seemed to get more play than others, and sometimes people muted their opinions rather than talking about them, especially if those opinions were perceived to be unpopular. Noelle-Neumann calls this the spiral of silence. The spiral of silence occurs when individuals who perceive that their opinions are popular express them, whereas those who do not think their opinions are popular remain quiet. This process occurs in a spiral, so that __________. In everyday life, people express their opinions in a variety of ways: they talk about them, they wear buttons, they put bumper stickers on their cars, and they post their views on social media. According to this theory, people are more apt to do these kinds of things when they perceive that others share their opinions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 나선형으로 진행되어 한쪽은 상당한 관심을 받고 다른 쪽은 거의 받지 못한다
det.analysis:
❌ ① 양쪽이 대중으로부터 동등한 관심을 받는다 — 원문은 비대칭적 관심 분배
❌ ② 모든 의견이 시간이 지남에 따라 침묵된다 — 원문은 한쪽만 침묵
❌ ③ 다수가 항상 소수 의견을 따른다 — 원문과 무관
✅ ④ 한쪽은 많은 관심을 받고 다른 쪽은 거의 받지 못한다 — 원문 일치 ←정답
det.tip: one side — considerable publicity / the other side — very little

ch: both sides receive equal attention from the public
all opinions are gradually silenced over time
the majority always follows the minority view
one side gains much publicity while the other gets little

questions.passage: As a political researcher in Germany, Noelle-Neumann observed that during election campaigns, certain views seemed to get more play than others, and sometimes people muted their opinions rather than talking about them, especially if those opinions were perceived to be unpopular. Noelle-Neumann calls this the spiral of silence. The spiral of silence occurs when individuals who perceive that their opinions are popular express them, whereas those who do not think their opinions are popular remain quiet. This process occurs in a spiral, so that one side of an issue ends up with considerable publicity and the other side with very little. In everyday life, people express their opinions in a variety of ways: they talk about them, they wear buttons, they put bumper stickers on their cars, and they post their views on social media. According to this theory, __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이 이론에 따르면, 사람들은 타인이 자신의 의견을 공유한다고 인식할 때 이런 행동을 할 가능성이 더 높다
det.analysis:
✅ ① 타인이 공유한다고 생각하는 의견을 표현하는 경향이 있다 — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② 모든 의견이 공적으로 동등하게 표현된다 — 원문은 비대칭 구조
❌ ③ 소셜 미디어가 의견 공유의 유일한 방법이다 — 본문은 다양한 방법 나열
❌ ④ 침묵은 정치 캠페인에서만 발생한다 — 본문은 일상생활도 포함
det.tip: people are more apt to do these kinds of things when they perceive that others share their opinions

ch: people tend to express views they think others share
all opinions are equally voiced in public
social media is the only way to share views
silence occurs only in political campaigns
